mp.pillar: Sustained Dominance: higher positions, longer presence and higher peak positions on Most Popular.
observations: Today's captured Most Popular order is identical to 2026-11-03 in all 99 positions, so the chart shows no risers, fallers, entries or exits; this is most likely a stale capture, not a frozen chart, and movement-based readings for today should be discounted.
On the cumulative pillar Steal An Egg (102 days), Brookhaven, DONT SPLASH (18 days), RIVALS, Murder Mystery 2 and 99 Nights in the Forest still lead.

By age, 85-122-day games sit at the 72nd median percentile and 4-12-month games at the 68th, against the 38th-42nd for 15-84-day games, so the mid-life trough (H-mp-009 at 48%) is again not visible, though only 11 games fall in the two older-young bands.
The weakest on the pillar are Cook the Chicken (by slapping it), Drag Drive Simulator, Phonk Edit Tower and My Avatar!, a mix of a one-joke chore game and older niche titles.
patterns: Recent updates consistently go with staying power: games left more than 25 days without an update stay fewer days (r=-0.66), and recently updated games consistently hold higher positions (H-mp-006 up to 76%).

Pricing consistently goes with dominance: median passes above 149 R$ rose to 73% (H-mp-001), and median products above 400 R$ split days on the chart at r=+0.39; H-mp-011 and H-mp-016 tend to hold at 65%.
Named seasonal events tend to go with more days on the chart (mech_event r=+0.34; H-mp-020 at 65%), the same evergreens that run a yearly calendar.
Big evergreens consistently convert fewer visits into favorites (H-mp-010 at 82%), so a high favorite rate marks a young game rather than a durable one.

Among profiled loops, incremental '+1' (79th percentile, four games), pet collection (78th) and party minigames (69th) lead while sports (21st), wave-survival co-op (20th) and tower defense (8th, one game) trail; the '+1' lead reflects young games still near their peak.

outliers.name: DONT SPLASH
outliers.note: Among the six strongest on the pillar at 18 days, against the rule that dominance comes with age; a sound-hunting horror hook (H-x-019) carried it there faster than any other young game.

outliers.name: Cook the Chicken (by slapping it)
outliers.note: The weakest on the pillar at 29 days with no passes and five products; a single-joke chore game gets on the chart but cannot hold position, in line with the retired H-x-022 idea.

te.pillar: Monetization Efficiency: earning a high position with modest CCU (Monetization Score ranks position × CCU, lower is better).
observations: Today's captured Top Earning order is identical to 2026-11-03 in all 477 positions, so movement readings are unavailable; the efficiency ranking still updates because CCU changed.

Donation hubs again top efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), followed by Clover RPG (newly profiled as a solo action RPG), Elemental Dungeons and Build and Burn (30 days).
The least efficient remain high-CCU free audiences: Fling Things and People (371 days without an update), Flee the Facility, Deagle Arena and Throw Food For Animals.
Efficiency rises steadily with age, from the 22nd median percentile at 15-42 days to the 46th-53rd at 6 weeks to a year and the 62nd past a year (H-te-001 at 84%).
patterns: High prices consistently pay: median products above 89 R$ split efficiency at r=+0.51 (H-te-005 at 89%), and median passes above 399-524 R$ and a pass above 699-999 R$ hold at 89% (H-te-025, H-te-006).

Steal-and-defend-base loops are consistently the weakest earners per player (r=-0.76, 11th percentile; H-te-024 at 89%), with 'Egg' (r=-0.74) and 'Steal' (r=-0.72) titles the worst keywords on the chart.

RPGs (r=+0.42), roleplay hubs (75th percentile), tower defense (71st) and PvP combat (64th; H-te-022 at 89%) consistently earn more per player, while Simulation (-0.26), solo loops (-0.28) and physics sandboxes (14th percentile; H-te-045 at 86%) consistently earn less.

Bigger servers and more complex builds consistently go with efficiency: servers above about 40 players split at r=+0.35 (H-te-007 at 89%) and complexity at rho=+0.27 (H-te-013 at 89%); the two likely share a cause in studio-scale games.
Idle or AFK income loops consistently earn less per player (H-te-038 up from 59% to 78%), while daily rewards still do not help (H-te-039 at 30%).

outliers.name: [RELEASE] Clover RPG
outliers.note: Among the four most efficient games yet profiled today as a solo action RPG, against the rule that solo loops earn less (H-te-028); an RPG catalogue sold to a small, invested anime-fan audience likely outweighs the solo format.

outliers.name: [UPDATE] Build and Burn
outliers.note: Among the six most efficient at 30 days with one pass, against the rule that efficiency comes after week 6; chapter releases and cash multipliers sold to a small racing audience are the likely reason.

outliers.name: Fling Things and People
outliers.note: The least efficient at 1,967 days and 371 days since its last update; a large free sandbox audience with six products shows that age without new things to buy does not lift efficiency.

tt.metric: daily position gain on Top Trending
observations: Destroy Verity (72 days), Can You Pass A Driving Test? (17 days), Draw a Flag! (25 days), Tesla Roadster Chase (14 days), Ragdoll Sandbox and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution lead momentum.

Risers were obby but you get smaller every stage (+21 at 534 days), Draw a Flag! (+17), +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (+15), Clean the Moon! (+12) and Ink Game (+11); Durian Garden (-20), Thai Quiz Duels (-15) and Fart Together (-9) fell most.

Seven games entered, among them DONT SWIM (10 days), Steal A Balut (17 days), Eat THE Ice Cream, HOOP JAM!, CRAZY 8 Ball and Pixel Arena; seven left, including The Strongest Battlegrounds [HALLOWEEN], Musical Chairs and Racket Rivals.

Games updated in the last day moved a median +4.5 against 0 for the rest (H-tt-005 up to 65%), and momentum falls after week 12, from the 51st-69th median percentile under 84 days to the 30th at 85-122 days.
patterns: A skill-based competitive core consistently goes with lower positions (r=-0.46, within-age -0.51; H-tt-054 at 72%), and PvP loops tend to climb more slowly (H-tt-011 at 68%); solo games, by contrast, hold higher positions today (r=+0.42), which leaves the solo-loop rule H-tt-008 near a coin flip at 52%.
Selling currency packs goes with slower climbs (r=-0.44 within age; H-tt-010 at 34%), and daily rewards go with markedly slower climbs (r=-0.55 within age, 8 games), tested from today.
Building or crafting tends to go with faster climbs (r=+0.41; H-tt-021 up to 67%), and 'Ragdoll' titles go with stronger momentum (r=+0.42), in line with the ragdoll wave (H-x-021 at 70%).

Verified creators go with higher positions within age (+0.42), tested from today; text-ad thumbnails tend to climb more slowly (H-tt-046 at 61%) while gameplay thumbnails consistently hold higher positions (H-tt-029 at 73%).
Frequent updates tend to go with higher positions (H-tt-040 at 67%), and servers above 24 players tend to go with lower ones (H-tt-049 at 63%).

summary: Data caveat: the 2026-11-04 snapshot captured Most Popular and Top Earning in exactly the same order as 2026-11-03 (all 99 and 477 positions), while Top Trending and Up-and-Coming changed normally. Day-over-day movement on those two charts is missing today; level-based tests still ran.

Competition splits the charts again: a skill-based competitive core and PvP go against breakout (Top Trending -0.46, Up-and-Coming -0.35/-0.36) while PvP combat consistently earns more per player (H-te-022 at 89%); solo loops split the same way, higher on Top Trending (+0.42) but lower in efficiency (-0.28).

Template reach without revenue holds across loops: steal-defend (11th percentile on Top Earning), physics sandboxes (14th) and Simulation-genre games earn the least per player while still entering the breakout charts (Steal A Balut, Farm Evolution, Ragdoll Sandbox); H-x-002 holds at 50%.

The don't-X horror wave keeps spawning: DONT SWIM entered Top Trending and led Up-and-Coming risers at 10 days and blind but dangerous entered Up-and-Coming, so H-x-019 rises to 55%; the Verity meme wave also persists (H-x-005 to 35%).

No gameplay videos were labelled for the fourth run: Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG and Basketball: Zero are still marked frames_ready with 0 frames and no contact sheets. No new outside research was waiting.
